title: rest: `POST /data/:object/import` (synchronous import) on an unregistered object answers 200 with a per-row `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, where `POST /data/:object` answers 404
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Found by the dev of #27501 ask (a), PR #27711 (os-dev-report `6508232970`, out-of-scope finding). Out of that card's scope: triage `6498786930` named only the async job door.

## What is wrong

The synchronous import door `POST /data/:object/import` (`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, the route registered at `${dataPath}/:object/import`) runs no existence check on `:object`. For a name with no object behind it, it answers 200 and reports `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` inside each row's result. `POST /data/:object` for the same name answers 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`. An automated importer that reads the status sees success for a misspelled object name.

#27501's reproduction step 3 measured this on `main` before #27711. #27711 closes the same gap on the async door `POST /data/:object/import/jobs` with `assertImportObjectExists`, called right after the API-exposure gate.

## Expected

The synchronous door refuses an unregistered object with the data door's answer (404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`, same envelope), before any row is written, with the same read and the same posture as #27711 (after the exposure gate, so it is no existence oracle). Refusing what used to answer 200 is a narrowing; triage decides `Clause-②`.

Re-check after #27711 merges: a JSON import to `POST /api/v1/data/<unregistered name>/import`; read the status and code.

Filed without `domain:*`; grading is triage's.
